units.source_text: 源氏公子打扮梳妆，直至日色甚暮，方始到会。

en.t: Prince Genji dressed and groomed himself, and only arrived at the gathering when the day had grown very late.
The household of the Minister of the Right and the others had grown anxious from waiting.

units.source_text: 他身穿一件白地彩纹中国薄绸常礼服，里面衬一件淡紫色衬袍，

en.t: He wore a formal everyday robe of thin Chinese silk, white with colored patterns, with a pale purple underrobe beneath it,

units.source_text: 拖着极长的后裾，夹在许多身穿大礼服的王公中间，

en.t: trailing an exceedingly long back hem as he moved among many princes and nobles dressed in grand ceremonial robes,

units.source_text: 显然是个风流潇洒的贵公子模样，大家肃然起敬。

en.t: plainly looking every inch a graceful and elegant young nobleman, so that everyone fell silent in respectful admiration.

units.source_text: 公子从容入座，其风采实在与众不同。

en.t: The prince calmly took his seat, and his bearing was truly unlike that of anyone else.

units.source_text: 花的色香也被减煞，使人看了反觉扫兴了。

en.t: Even the flowers seemed to lose something of their color and fragrance, and looking at them instead felt disappointing.
